title: Planting trees in Downtown Santa Monica
description:
New trees take root in Downtown Santa Monica.
The Public Landscape Division is planting African Fern Pines throughout the downtown core as part of the City of Santa Monica Realignment Plan. Crews are also pruning existing trees to enhance the downtown look and feel.
These beautiful new trees will make an immediate impact and will help shape the streetscape for generations to come.
transcript_text: Hey everyone, my name is Robert Casinetta with the city of Santa Monica's public landscape division. Um, here we're planting an African fern pine in downtown Santa Monica as part of our realignment plan. Uh, as you may have seen, crews are pruning downtown. We're planting uh these 36-in [music] box trees. They're a significantly larger size for a more immediate impact to our downtown streetscape. [music] Um, African firm pines are a great urban tree and they're going to hopefully grace our streets for the next decades to come.
